title: Add text-to-speech for phonetic result
description: Add an action to speak the NATO phonetic result using macOS text-to-speech.
design: Use Node.js child_process.exec to run macOS 'say' command. Add as an Action in the ActionPanel.

title: Package extension for Raycast Store
description: Prepare and submit the NATO Phonetic extension for listing on the Raycast Store. Includes meeting store requirements, adding metadata, screenshots, and submitting for review.
acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] Icon: 512x512 PNG, works in light/dark themes
- [ ] Screenshots: 3-6 images at 2000x1250px (16:10)
- [ ] package.json: author, MIT license, latest API, categories
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md with version history
- [ ] README.md if setup required
- [ ] npm run build passes
- [ ] npm run lint passes
- [ ] npm run publish submitted

title: Alternate panel display like Raycast Calculator
description: Implement a visual panel display similar to Raycast's built-in calculator - showing input on left, arrow, output on right with labels underneath.
design: Use Detail component with Detail.Metadata panel on right side. Markdown shows the phonetic output prominently, metadata panel shows structured info (Input, Pronunciation). This approximates the calculator's side-by-side layout using available API.

title: Code quality and linting with Biome
description: Add Biome for fast linting and formatting. Replace or complement existing ESLint/Prettier setup.

title: Build NATO Phonetic Raycast Extension
description: Create a Raycast extension that converts text input to NATO phonetic alphabet. Features: real-time conversion, word separation with | delimiter, copy to clipboard.
